title: Dear Kirio-kun
overview: They may be competing over the same boy, but the line between rival and friend gets blurrier by the day.

title: When I Saw Your Tears That Day
overview: Who is this Satsuki, and why is she so close to Kirio? Nami and Aimi refuse to accept this unforeseen development.

title: Dragon Kirio
overview: Aimi wants to get cursed in return for Kirio's love.

title: Treasured Moments
overview: The good news is that Aimi has Kirio's contact information. The bad news is that she now has texting anxiety. But there's a reason why she's so persistent about her feelings.

title: Secrets
overview: High school relationships are complicated. Especially when love triangles turn into love polygons.

title: School Trip Magic
overview: Aimi and Nami conspire with Manda to be put into Kirio's group for a school trip.

title: Steamy, Spicy, Red-hot Night
overview: Aimi's excited since they're all spending the entire day with Kirio! But Kirio has something weighing on his mind.

title: Can't Say It, Won't Say It.
overview: Momose works up the courage to tell Nami how he feels.

title: I Hear Kirio's Quitting the Team
overview: Aimi reconciles with Nami in the middle of a sting operation. Now they must decide how to approach Kirio.

title: It Was All a Lie
overview: Aimi and Nami's plan to make Kirio happy backfires.

title: Kirio Fan Club
overview: Kirio reaches his breaking point. Now it's up to Aimi, Nami, and his friends to bring him back from the brink.
